weapons.Name: PM pistol
weapons.Info: The time-tested Pistolet Makarova is still used by Russian special forces  due to its widespread availability, exceptional reliability, moderate weight, compact size and no shortage of 9x18mm PM rounds. Dealing low damage is its only drawback.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: The silencer device muffles shot and hides flame that unmasks shooter
weapons.WtaskInfo: Makarov pistol equipped with a laser pointer and PBS for easier targeting. More balanced version of a pistol with the necessary properties for the quiet special operations.

weapons.Name: APS automatic pistol
weapons.Info: Initially intended as a sidearm for artillery soldiers, the Stechkin automatic pistol gradually phased out of active service during the 1970s. Regardless, the APS is still being used today by the Russian Interior Ministry and the FSB special forces  due to its firepower and efficiency. It can operate in fully automatic mode.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: The silencer device (PBS) muffles shot and hides flame that unmasks shooter
weapons.WtaskInfo: APB can work silently, keeping the damage and rate of fire. Overall large size of a pistol with PBS compensates with overall balancing and low recoil.

weapons.Name: Glock 18 automatic pistol
weapons.Info: Produced in Austria by Glock Ges.m.b.H, the Glock Model 18 delivers an excellent compromise between lightness, compactness and combat effectiveness. The pistol can fire in full automatic mode at an extremely high rate of fire.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: The silencer device muffles shot and hides flame that unmasks a shooter
weapons.WtaskInfo: Equipped with a silencer Glock becomes a serious weapon when it comes to high fire density and quiet operation. Only the most elite fighters have this secret version of this gun

weapons.Name: Kedr SMG
weapons.Info: Originally designed by Yevgeny Dragunov, the Kedr submachine gun has firmly established itself in various Russian law enforcement agencies due to its compact size and rate of fire. Its main application is in CQB situations.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: Laser point sight + silencer
weapons.WtaskInfo: Antiterror kit consists of a special silencer and laser pointer, which substantially increases the tactical capabilities of weapon.

weapons.Name: H&K MP5k SMG
weapons.Info: Produced by the german defense manufacturing company Heckler & Koch, the MP5k is a shortened version of the MP5, the most popular submachine gun in the world. It was designed specifically for police and SWAT teams performing tasks in urban settings.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: Mod kit consists of a red dot sight Kobra and PBS. It is used in silent special operations.
weapons.WtaskInfo: Collimator sight and silencer layout, developed and adopted for the GSG-9 in Bosnia during the war of 92-95.

weapons.Name: KAC PDW rifle
weapons.Info: The new assault rifle developed for the new ammo type to increase the damage at ranges up to 300m. Compact and lightweight like a SMG and as powerful as an assault rifle. Works great on mid-range due to the balance of accuracy and efficiency.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: The silencer device muffles shot and hides flame that unmasks a shooter. Collimator sigth gives an ability to aim faster.
weapons.WtaskInfo: Modification of the KAC PDW rifle equipped with silencer and Mepro 21M sight, adopted by the U.S. Special Operations Command. Allows the operator to conduct aimed fire at medium ranges without being detected.

weapons.Name: IZH-43 shotgun
weapons.Info: A short barrel variant of a classic side-by-side hunting shotgun produced by the Russian firearms manufacturer Izhevsky Mechanichesky Zavod, well known throughout the world under the trademark Baikal. Its excellent balance ensures convenient and quick aiming.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: Large field of view of the holographic sight and precise mark allows the shooter to quickly respond to emerging threats.
weapons.WtaskInfo: A few masters, who can intelligently use this weapon to fight, for greater convenience modify this gun with a collimator sight.

weapons.Name: H&K USP pistol
weapons.Info: A tactical modification of the well known german pistol, USP. The HK USP is a serious weapon in skilled hands
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: Special silencer -  Osprey from Silencerco reliably mutes the shot and hides the flame
weapons.WtaskInfo: Additional silencer for USP to proceed on silent special operations. USECs commanders special

weapons.Name: Sig Sauer P226R
weapons.Info: Manufactured by SIG Sauer, the P226 is a full-sized, service-type pistol well known for its overall quality and reliability. It is widely used by the U.S. Navy SEALs, FBI field agents and many other elite military and law enforcement professionals.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: The silencer device muffles shot and hides flame that unmasks shooter

weapons.Name: Bizon-2B SMG
weapons.Info: Developed at the request of the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs, the Bizon sub-machine gun is primarily intended for counter-terrorist and law enforcement units that usually need fast and accurate fire at close ranges. Based on the layout of the AKS-74U carbine, the Bizon features a very large magazine capacity.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: Modification kit consisting of a red dot sight Kobra and the PBS. Used in silent special operations.
weapons.WtaskInfo: Bizon in this configuration is a rare option for urban special operations

weapons.Name: FN SCAR-L rifle
weapons.Info: The Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle is a modular rifle made by FN Herstal for the United States Special Operations Command as a replacement for the M16. Although the light version (SCAR-L) hasnt been successfully adopted by the U.S. Army, it is still actively used by PMCs worldwide.
weapons.WtaskGearDesc: 4x magnifying optics specially adapted for mounting on assault rifles and carbines
